content: The Occult Court says Ibn Turka's occult-imperial project was more focused on the direct transformation of Turko-Mongol warlords into occult philosopher-kings, in contrast with ʿAlī Ṣafī's 'occult democracy'; footnote 26 says the New Brethren were born in Mamluk Cairo around 1400 and that Sultan Barqūq (r. 1382-1399) was patron to the original New Brethren.
